items.example: The story is all over the news.
items.simple: Every TV and website is talking about it.

items.example: The bus drivers are going on strike tomorrow.
items.simple: Workers stop working so the boss will listen to them.

items.example: The cost of living is crazy right now.
items.simple: How much money you need each month for food and a home.

items.example: Did you see the headline this morning?
items.simple: The big words at the top of a news story.

items.example: Are you voting in the election?
items.simple: A day when people choose who will lead the country.

items.example: There was a big protest in the city centre.
items.exampleTr: Şehir merkezinde büyük bir protesto vardı.
items.simple: Many people walk together and shout because they do not like something.

items.example: Unemployment is high among young people.
items.simple: Many people want a job but cannot find one.

items.example: Inflation makes everything more expensive.
items.exampleTr: Enflasyon her şeyi daha pahalı yapıyor.
items.simple: Prices go up and up, so your money buys less.

items.example: According to the news, it'll snow tonight.
items.exampleTr: Haberlere göre bu gece kar yağacak.
items.simple: This is what the news says.

items.example: Half of what I see online is fake news.
items.simple: A story that looks true but is not true.

items.example: Her video went viral overnight.
items.simple: Lots and lots of people see it online very fast.

items.example: There are more homeless people in the city now.
items.exampleTr: Artık şehirde daha çok evsiz var.
items.simple: A person who has no home to live in.

items.example: Prices have risen sharply this year.
items.simple: Something goes up very fast, in a short time.

items.example: Many refugees need a safe place to live.
items.exampleTr: Birçok mülteci yaşamak için güvenli bir yere ihtiyaç duyuyor.
items.simple: A person who had to leave their country because it was not safe.

items.example: I'm sick of the news. It's always bad.
items.simple: You do not want to hear any more of it.

items.example: His speech made the headlines.
items.simple: So many people talk about it that all the news shows it.

items.example: I was stuck in a traffic jam for an hour.
items.simple: Lots of cars cannot move on the road.

items.example: Housing is a hot topic right now.
items.exampleTr: Konut şu an gündemin sıcak konusu.
items.simple: Everyone wants to talk about it now.

items.en: Prices have gone through the roof.
items.example: Prices have gone through the roof lately.
items.simple: Things now cost so much more money than before.

items.example: Poverty is still a big problem.
items.simple: Having almost no money for food or a home.

items.example: Why is there so much tax on petrol?
items.exampleTr: Benzinde neden bu kadar çok vergi var?
items.simple: Money you pay to the government.

items.example: Wages haven't gone up for years.
items.simple: The money workers get for the hours they work.

items.example: She works as a journalist for a big paper.
items.exampleTr: Büyük bir gazetede gazeteci olarak çalışıyor.
items.simple: A person who writes or tells the news.

items.example: I use public transport every day.
items.simple: Buses and trains that anyone can use.
